text_block_list.text:
While I'm walking around town on my
day off...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
C'mon, Fine. You done yet or what?
Let's head
back already.
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
No can do! ♪ We've only just started our
ramen
tour!
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
We've already been to three
restaurants...
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
Those were just warmups! You said you'd
escort
me, didn't you?
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
You've got to play along, or I miiight
just decide
not to give you my data after
all. ♪
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
Tch. I should've been more specific
about the
deal...
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
Yikes, it's Air Shakur! She looks even
scarier in
the flesh...
text_block_list.name: Pedestrian A

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's always on edge. I don't envy

whoever's racing her next, 'cause she
looks ready
to fly off the handle again.
text_block_list.name: Pedestrian B

text_block_list.text: Oh crap. Think she can hear us?
text_block_list.name: Pedestrian A

text_block_list.text: Probably. Let's get out of here.
text_block_list.name: Pedestrian B

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Shakur. I didn't understand all of
those
words. Did they mean you look
strong?
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
No, idiot. They're bad-mouthing me.
Saying that
I'm an antisocial freak who's
gonna get someone
hurt.
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
What?! Really? That's so rude! I'm going
to go set
them straight!
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text: Don't be stupid. There's no point.
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text: But... doesn't it make you sad?
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text: As if. Why should I care? Not my problem.
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
Background noise like that isn't worth
factoring
into anything, so I just filter it
all out.
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
Sides, they'll shut up if I win enough. So,
just
leave 'em be.
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text: I see... Shakur, you really are noble.
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
Huh? How did you get that from what I
just said?
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
You keep working towards your goals,
no matter
what. I think that's really
noble.
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
But if the "noise" ever gets you down,
the sound
of slurping ramen is sure to
drown it out! ♪
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
I'll always be happy to join you! No
matter the
place!
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text:
You just want to eat ramen! ...Hmph, I
can't
stomach people like you.
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur

text_block_list.text:
Huh? I can stomach pretty much
anything! I'll
prove it to you at the next
place!
text_block_list.name: Fine Motion

text_block_list.text: That's not what I meant... Ugh.
text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
